Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the recent onboarding call. Before we finalize our vendor record, our AP team needs confirmation on two items:

1) Preferred delivery channel for invoices — we have an AP portal (preferred) but can accept PDF invoices to ap-invoices@novumlabs.com if portal onboarding will take longer.
2) VAT/tax evidence — we need Redwood to provide a VAT certificate and the remit-to details (bank/beneficiary) for our SAP upload.

- Whether Redwood will upload invoices to our portal (via SSO/partner integration) or continue emailing PDFs?

- Where we can pull VAT evidence (certificate) and the remit-to name/address you want on the invoice.

We have PO #NL-4512 ready; please include on the invoice.

Thanks,

- Delivery channel: We can push invoices into your AP portal via SFTP/API integration within ~2 weeks (depends on SSO/config). As a temporary measure we will send signed PDF invoices to ap-invoices@novumlabs.com and CC bookkeeping@novumlabs.com.
- Format: We include a human-readable PDF by default; we can also provide an accompanying XML invoice (UBL) or a Peppol envelope for EU customers on request. Attached is a sample PDF + a simple XML schema mapping (redwood_sample_invoice_v2.pdf).
- VAT evidence & remit-to: Attached is a scanned VAT certificate for Redwood (VAT_certificate_UK_novum.pdf) and our remit details you can use for SAP: Redwood Inference Ltd, 23 Foundry Rd, London, UK, VAT GB123456789, Bank: FirstBridge Bank, IBAN: GB29FBIB12345678901234.

Action items I propose:
1) I'll open an integration ticket with your AP team (cc'd) to schedule SSO.
2) For this quarter we send PDFs to ap-invoices@novumlabs.com; please confirm the exact mailbox and any subject-line PO formatting you need (e.g., PO NL-4512 in subject).

Attaching: redwood_sample_invoice_v2.pdf, VAT_certificate_UK_novum.pdf

Can you both confirm:

2) Any compliance concerns about emailing invoice PDFs (sensitive info) to external mailboxes — need to route via SFTP instead?
